description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class named TicketController responsible for handling HTTP requests related to Ticket entities, including creating, editing, deleting, and displaying ticket forms within a web application.

classes.name: TicketController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing ticket operations such as creating, editing, and deleting tickets.

methods.name: showTicketForm
methods.description: Handles requests to display the ticket form for creating or editing a ticket.

methods.name: saveTicket
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new or existing ticket.

methods.name: editTicket
methods.description: Retrieves a ticket for editing and displays it in a form.

methods.name: getLoggedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user's ID from Spring Security context.
